# langsmith_composite_evaluator (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith composite evaluator: a feedback score computed for each run as a weighted combination of other feedback keys. It replaces the retired `langsmith_feedback_formula` and takes the same inputs.

LangSmith creates two objects for it: a code evaluator that computes the score, and a run rule that runs it on the project's or dataset's traces. This resource manages both, and destroying it deletes both. LangSmith has no update endpoint for composite evaluators and does not return the formula, so changing any input replaces the resource, and a change made to the generated evaluator code in the LangSmith UI is not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A composite score: the weighted average of two feedback keys, computed for
# every run in the project once both keys have been scored.
#
# This replaces the retired langsmith_feedback_formula and takes the same
# inputs. Changing any of them replaces the composite evaluator.
resource "langsmith_composite_evaluator" "quality" {
  feedback_key     = "quality"
  aggregation_type = "avg"
  session_id       = langsmith_project.example.id

  formula_parts = jsonencode([
    { part_type = "weighted_key", weight = 1.0, key = "correctness" },
    { part_type = "weighted_key", weight = 0.5, key = "helpfulness" },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aggregation_type` (String) How the weighted parts combine: `avg` (weighted average) or `sum` (weighted sum). Changing it forces replacement.
- `feedback_key` (String) The feedback key the composite score is recorded under. Changing it forces replacement.
- `formula_parts` (String) JSON-encoded array of weighted feedback keys, e.g. `jsonencode([{ part_type = "weighted_key", weight = 1.0, key = "correctness" }])`. The score is only computed for a run once every key in the formula has a score. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `dataset_id` (String) The dataset to compute the score for. Exactly one of `session_id` or `dataset_id` must be set. Changing it forces replacement.
- `session_id` (String) The project (session) to compute the score for. Exactly one of `session_id` or `dataset_id` must be set. Changing it forces replacement.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `evaluator_id` (String) The ID of the code evaluator LangSmith created to compute the score.
- `id` (String) The resource ID, equal to `rule_id`.
- `rule_id` (String) The ID of the run rule LangSmith created to run the evaluator.
